title: ESPN lays off NFL analyst Ryan Clark in stunning move as first wave of expected cuts begins

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: ESPN lays off NFL analyst Ryan Clark in stunning move as first wave of expected cuts begins
sources.description: Clark, who played 13 years in the league before shifting to broadcasting, was set to be “a large part” of its Super Bowl coverage and was on “Monday Night Countdown” for three seasons.
